title: Porting KVM to SmartOS - Brian Cantrill, Joyent, KVM Forum 2011
summary: Bryan Cantrill of Joyent describes the experience of porting KVM to SmartOS, an Illumos-based OS, at KVM Forum 2011. He covers the process, the pain points and how DTrace helped.
why: Cited as evidence that the KVM port was hard work and as background on Cantrill's illumos virtualization experience.
